final_rationale: The verdict changes only because the Actor abandoned the broader claim of unconditional compliant certification and aligned the position to what the existing record can bear. No new admissible evidence was received. Under the stated policy, aggregate readiness passing and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch-readiness context, but do not satisfy the material-weakness condition by themselves. The unresolved redaction-category routing weakness and draft mitigation still block a clean compliance finding. However, the available record does support a narrower, policy-bounded position: certification with explicit caveats in the audit packet. That is materially different from saying the issue is resolved or that the mitigation is approved. The caveat is not cured by the Actor's explanation; it remains a live compliance predicate that must stay disclosed in the certification record. On that narrower basis, compliant_with_caveats is the most proportionate final classification.
remaining_concerns: No genuinely new admissible evidence was added; the change is based on narrowing the audited claim, not strengthening the record.
A material weakness still remains in public-records triage, concentrated in redaction-category routing.
The mitigation artifact is still draft-state and lacks required approval fields including at least an owner and alert threshold, so the approved-mitigation predicate is not met.
There is still no admissible evidence of approved risk acceptance.
Caveated compliance is supportable only if the final certification record actually preserves the disclosed limitation; caveat-free certification remains unsupported.
